title: bench_multi still tests a whole-topic research key's term as * but coord names it WHOLE, and compares a key's topic to the article path though a topic over 80 characters is cut and hashed in the key
goal: bench_multi.worked_key treats a research key whose term is coord.WHOLE as matched by any fact on the topic's article, and matches a key whose topic was cut and hashed by coord.topic_key to the article it stands for

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_multi as B,coord;B.origin_path=lambda r:'bare';B.agent_email=lambda n:'a@example.com';B.added_facts=lambda b,m,e:[{'path':'public/x/y.md','text':'unrelated fact','at':1.0}];w=B.worked_key('root',{'base':'b'},coord.research_key('public/x/y',coord.WHOLE),1,'agent-1',{});print('whole-topic key worked:',w);sys.exit(0 if w else 1)
